title: SEBI Order Against Wealthmax Solutions for Fake Investment Advice
description: Unregistered advisors lure retail investors with promises of guaranteed returns and exclusive stock tips through unregistered firms.

title: SEBI Warning to Entities Regarding AI-Powered Boss Scam
description: Fraudsters impersonate CEOs and senior executives on messaging platforms to trick employees into making urgent fund transfers.

title: RBI Advisory on Unauthorised Telegram Crypto Trading Platforms
description: Fraudsters use Telegram signal channels and fake exchanges to orchestrate crypto exit scams outside Indian jurisdiction.

title: SEBI Caution Against AI Deepfake Guaranteed Return Schemes
description: AI-generated videos of market experts and the Prime Minister endorse fraudulent guaranteed-return schemes on social media platforms.

title: RBI Alert on Fictitious Lottery Offers and Cheap Funds
description: Fraudsters send fictitious offers using fake logos and names like Reserve Bank to trick the public into paying fees.

title: BSE Cautions Against Deepfake Video of CEO Recommending Stocks
description: A fraudulent AI-generated video featuring the BSE CEO provides fake stock recommendations to viewers on social media.

title: SEBI Crackdown on WhatsApp Pump and Dump Investment Scams
description: Scammers use social media and messaging platforms to hype low-quality stocks before dumping shares for profit.

title: Beware of Fake Fund House Groups on WhatsApp
description: Scammers create fake WhatsApp groups pretending to be well-known fund houses to offer phony stock tips and courses.

title: Binary Trading Scam via Unregulated Apps and APK Files
description: Unregulated platforms lure investors with guaranteed returns but require downloading risky APK files from unknown sources.

title: NSE Warning on Forged SEBI Letterheads for STT Payment
description: Fraudsters use forged SEBI letterheads and logos to demand payment of Securities Transaction Tax for releasing funds.

title: SBI Phishing Alert for Fake Account Lock Text Messages
description: Phishing messages claim bank accounts are locked and request users to click malicious links to verify credentials.
